mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior 3 months indicates accommodative monetary policy that lowers discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where FEDFUNDS declines for 3 consecutive months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.0% for three consecutive months, restrictive monetary policy increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.0% for 3 consecutive months, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in unemployment rate and increase in housing starts signals robust labor market conditions and strong consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: strong labor and housing demand regime
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where UNRATE declines and HOUST increases, or Rank IC for interaction term falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a high consumer demand regime defined by rising retail sales and housing starts, corporate earnings growth drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where RSAFS and HOUST both exceed 12-month moving averages, or Rank IC for regime condition falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in non-farm payrolls over the prior 3 months indicates strengthening labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where PAYEMS increases for 3 consecutive months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 5.0% for two consecutive months, economic weakness reduces consumer confidence and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where UNRATE exceeds 5.0% for 2 consecutive months, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in industrial production and increase in federal funds rate signals monetary tightening-induced supply contraction, reducing corporate output and driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where INDPRO declines and FEDFUNDS rises, or Rank IC for interaction term falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a high industrial production regime where output exceeds 105, strong manufacturing activity drives corporate profit growth, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where INDPRO exceeds 105, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
